_doc: Curated vacancy set for the filter snapshot test (tests/test_filters_snapshot.py). One entry per behaviour class. stable_key = [org, title]. job = fetcher-shaped dict handed to merge_vacancies/merge_board_vacancies. _class is documentation only. _seed describes pre-existing DB state the harness must create before running an entry point (archived row, archived_hash tombstone, first_seen offset, company status, initial status). _excluded_country, when present, is the canonical country name the harness must pin into filter_vacancies._EXCLUDED_COUNTRIES so the geo gate fires. Frozen 'today' = 2026-06-23.
